baseline_density_reference.mass_conservation: rho_current=rho_reference_geometry/det(F_total); do not also multiply by a second thermal-density correction.
baseline_density_reference.temperature_assignment: Source gives density without temperature; assigned to 20 degC room-temperature reference consistently with adjacent physical-property table.

conditional_density_scenario.scope: source-T-driven conditional geometry comparison until native caloric and work identities align

density_reference.source: explicit native material-feedback pilot nominal density convention, not measured foil density
density_reference.temperature_assignment: back-mapped through the unchanged bounded expansion law so rho_ref(300 K)=8000 kg/m3

excluded_physics: melt fraction, latent heat, flow, and vaporization

material.name: Austenitic stainless steel Type 304
material.qualification: Generic grade benchmark; not a batch-certified or strain-rate-qualified foil constitutive law. Density only is a separately identified native-pilot nominal8000-at300K scenario; not a measured or batch-qualified foil density.

melting.guard: The expansion/elasticity record already rejects above 773.15 K. At or above 1672.15 K additionally label possible melting. No solid elasticity through this interval.
melting.interpretation: Producer's melting interval for Type 304 shapes; not a measured phase diagram for this foil batch.
melting.source_grade: TP 304; separate from the neighboring TP 304L row

out_of_range_policy: reject; never clip, hold endpoint, or extrapolate

poisson_ratio.status: No grade-and-temperature-qualified value bound in v1. Uniaxial rod mechanics does not require nu; any isotropic 3D benchmark must declare nu separately as a benchmark assumption.

proof_stress_screening.condition: solution annealed +AT, DIN EN 10088-3 bar product
proof_stress_screening.use: Optional conservative benchmark warning proxy, not calibrated foil yield and not a plasticity return map. Passing it does not prove elastic behavior. The 550 degC datum does not extend the mechanical admissible temperature range.

sources.title: Stainless Steel Shapes

specific_heat.use: Room-temperature datum only; no caloric EOS or melt enthalpy is supplied.

thermal_conductivity.use: Room-temperature datum only; no temperature-dependent heating feedback is authorized by this datum.

thermal_expansion.derivation: s(T_i)=mean_alpha(T_i)*(T_i-293.15). Interpolate s, not the tabulated mean coefficient as a tangent.
thermal_expansion.reference_policy: The caller must explicitly specify T_ref within valid_temperature_K as the stress-free geometry temperature.
thermal_expansion.relative_length_change_units: m/m relative to length at 293.15 K
thermal_expansion.source_quantity: mean engineering linear expansion coefficient from 20 degC to the endpoint
thermal_expansion.tangent_definition: ds/dT is piecewise constant; the current-length coefficient is alpha(T)=(ds/dT)/(1+s(T)). Integrating alpha gives log stretch.
thermal_expansion.uncertainty: Source supplies rounded engineering values without statistical uncertainty. Piecewise interpolation is a declared implementation choice; sub-knot behavior is unmeasured.

young_modulus.uncertainty: No source statistical uncertainty; no high-strain-rate qualification.
